_: The colours of the owner's phone, sampled 2026-09-09 from two screenshots he supplied (user/Screenshot_20260909-0039*.png) by decoding the PNGs and reading pixels. Not eyeballed.
_finding: His app does NOT show the Material 3 baseline palette. It runs dynamic colour, taken from his wallpaper on Android 12+, so the scheme is magenta and violet where the baseline is lavender on near-black. docs/reference/material3-dark.json is still correct for a phone with dynamic colour off; this file is what 'looks like my app' actually means.
_limit: A browser cannot reproduce dynamic colour. The page ships these as its default tokens; anyone whose wallpaper differs will see the owner's scheme rather than their own, which is the honest trade for looking like his app.
